shared_elements: frontal anthropomorphic figure or body with arms/hands
justification: The strongest correspondence is that both include a frontal anthropomorphic presence with arms/hands and a waist/belt area, accompanied by profile animals and linear patterned carving. The biggest difference is that A is dominated by a dense, frontal, ornate human/supernatural figure with headdress and enclosing decoration, while B is organized in sparse horizontal registers of mostly schematic profile animals around a much less explicit anthropomorphic form.
